# TimeAxisHeader hover paints every tick cell steel-blue via grid header hover

## Context

Engine 14 release blocker surfaced by `@tobiu` inspecting `https://neomjs.com/dist/production/examples/gantt/basic/index.html` (`neo-theme-neo-light` default; also affects `neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-neo-dark`, `neo-theme-dark`, and `neo-theme-cyberpunk` across every Gantt, Scheduler, and Timeline grid). Hovering anywhere over the timeline header turns the entire two-tier time axis (`9 Nov` major row and all `Mon 9`–`Sun 15` minor tick cells simultaneously) into a solid steel-blue (`#6d93b7` in `light` / `neo-light`, `var(--purple-500)` in `neo-dark`) with a `pointer` hand cursor, even though `TimeAxisHeader` is a non-clickable scale projection rather than a sortable column button.

## The Problem

`Neo.timeline.TimeAxisHeader` (`src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs:72`) includes `'neo-grid-header-button'` in `baseCls: ['neo-timeline-header', 'neo-grid-header-button']` so `Neo.grid.header.Toolbar` layouts and seam borders treat it as a column header item. However:

1. `resources/css/src/grid/header/Button.css:8` sets `cursor: pointer;` on `.neo-grid-header-button`, and lines `48–52` set:
   ```css
   .neo-grid-header-button:hover {
       background-color: var(--grid-header-button-background-color-hover);
       border-color    : var(--grid-header-button-border-hover-color);
       box-shadow      : var(--grid-header-button-box-shadow-hover);
   }
   ```
2. `resources/css/src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css:4–17` styles `.neo-timeline-header.neo-grid-header-button` (`specificity 0,2,0`) at rest with `background: var(--neo-timeline-header-background)`, but defines **no `:hover` override** and **no `cursor: default`**. Because `.neo-grid-header-button:hover` also has `0,2,0` specificity (and sets `background-color` explicitly on hover), hovering anywhere inside the virtualized `TimeAxisHeader` paints the entire multi-day / multi-hour header strip with `--grid-header-button-background-color-hover` (`#6d93b7` steel-blue in `theme-light` and `theme-neo-light`, `var(--purple-500)` in `theme-neo-dark`) behind dark `#1f2937` / `#4b5563` tick text.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs:72, 180`: `baseCls: ['neo-timeline-header', 'neo-grid-header-button']`, `sortable_: false`. `TimeAxisHeader` is a single virtualized component projecting `.neo-timeline-tick-major` and `.neo-timeline-tick-minor` spans across `[minPx, maxPx]`; it is never clicked to sort.
- `resources/css/src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css:4–25`: owns structural and state styling of `.neo-timeline-header.neo-grid-header-button`.
- `resources/css/src/grid/header/Button.css:8, 48–68`: owns interactive sort-button hover chrome for ordinary grid columns.
- Design authority: `src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs:8–15` `@summary` / `@description` (*"Two-tier timeline header (`Neo.timeline.TimeAxisHeader`) projecting only viewport-visible major and minor ticks... Instead of mounting or measuring a `Neo.grid.header.Button` per time slot, `TimeAxisHeader` spans the full `timeAxis.totalSize` width"*). A whole-axis button hover across all time slots contradicts the virtualized multi-slot scale contract.

## The Fix

1. In `resources/css/src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css`, set `cursor: default;` on `.neo-timeline-header.neo-grid-header-button` and explicitly neutralize `.neo-grid-header-button:hover` on `&:hover` so background, border, and box-shadow remain anchored to `--neo-timeline-header-background` and `--neo-timeline-border-color` (preserving `&.neo-locked-end:first-child` left seam border and `:not(:last-child)` right seam border if applicable).
2. Rebuild CSS (`node ./buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all`) and verify `npm run check-theme-surfaces`.
3. Add a Playwright test (e.g. under `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/` or `test/playwright/component/timeline/`) hovering `.neo-timeline-header` across `neo-theme-neo-light`, `neo-theme-light`, and `neo-theme-neo-dark` and asserting `getComputedStyle(header).backgroundColor` and `cursor` (`'default'`) do not mutate on `:hover`.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Hovering over `.neo-timeline-header` in `examples/gantt/basic`, `examples/scheduler/basic`, and `examples/timeline/basic` causes zero background-color, border-color, or box-shadow change across all five shipped themes (`neo-theme-neo-light`, `neo-theme-neo-dark`, `neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-dark`, `neo-theme-cyberpunk`).
- [ ] `.neo-timeline-header` computes `cursor: default` rather than `pointer`.
- [ ] Automated Playwright test asserts computed `backgroundColor` before and during `hover()` on `.neo-timeline-header` (red on `dev`, green on branch) and `npm run build-themes` + `npm run check-theme-surfaces` pass.
- [ ] Before/after whole-page screenshots of `examples/gantt/basic` hovered in `neo-theme-neo-light` are attached on the PR.

## Out of Scope

- Styling the non-timeline column header buttons (`Task`, `Studio`, etc.) to match `--neo-timeline-header-background` (tracked separately in the sibling Gantt/Scheduler column-header surface ticket).
- Interactive click-to-zoom on individual timeline ticks.

## Avoided Traps

- Removing `'neo-grid-header-button'` from `TimeAxisHeader#baseCls` without updating `Neo.grid.header.Toolbar` / `Wrapper` selectors and `.neo-scheduler` / `.neo-gantt` `height: 100%` rules that query `.neo-grid-header-button`. Keeping the structural class while neutralizing `cursor` and `&:hover` in `TimeAxisHeader.css` is zero-blast-radius.
